description: FastAPI router module defining endpoints for user management, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting users with appropriate security and database interactions.

classes.name: APIRouter

methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of users with optional filtering by search term, role, and active status.

methods.name: get_user( user_id: str, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_active_user), db = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch detailed information about a specific user, including project and bug statistics.

methods.name: create_user( user_data: UserCreate, admin_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_admin_user), db = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new user, restricted to admin users.

methods.name: update_user( user_id: str, user_data: UserUpdate, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_active_user), db = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update user data; users can update their own profile, admins can update any user.

methods.name: delete_user( user_id: str, admin_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_admin_user), db = Depends(get_database) )
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to deactivate a user account; restricted to admin users.
